dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey there, Honorary Knight! This cross-country race turned out pretty successful, right?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Besides Jade Pitching, there are a few other fun events too, you may run into plenty of familiar faces!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Huh? Busy? Me? I wouldn't say that, unless my schedule's packed with patrols and battles, it doesn't really count as busy!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When we met in Sumeru, I was off-duty and on vacation. I was just having fun, helping Collei with a few things, nothing tiring at all.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: And it's the same this time, just lending a hand with some small tasks here and there around the camp, no pressure whatsoever.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Plus, the Knights of Favonius have also been reorganizing. Master Jean's planning to assign me a few helpers so my schedule won't be as packed as before.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: One of them's a really talented trainee named Gretel. She'll be learning outrider skills from me and hopefully start handling some of the easier tasks soon.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Haha, nothing like that! I'm just sharing a few basic skills, nothing special. I'll still be the Knights' one and only independent Outrider!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Master Jean mentioned that the Knights have learned a lot over the years and we don't plan on forming a separate recon squad.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Instead, each squad's going to develop its own recon team based on their specific duties and strengths.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The way I'm training Gretel will be used as an example in the teaching materials to inspire future training across all squads...

choices.text: So you're setting the standard now?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Pretty much! To do that, I'll have to write a ton of reports and summaries, that's when things will really start getting busy.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Ugh, paperwork like that always gives me a headache. It's not my strong suit at all.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: At times like this, I should ask Eula for advice... she always balances her missions and captain's desk duties perfectly!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The only downside is... every now and then, she gets so busy and she practically vanishes. I'll pass on that!

choices.text: The Outriders are gonna expand their ranks!
Congrats on making a new friend, Amber!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You mean Yanfei? Haha, then I should be congratulating myself too!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When Eula first told me about this legal expert, I was a little worried she'd be too strict.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But once we met, I realized I was worrying for nothing!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Though we like different foods, prefer different kinds of books, and have such different stories and experiences in the past...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But it's incredible that many of the things we enjoy fall into the areas the other isn't familiar with, yet has always been curious about.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: That's why, whenever we're hanging out, there's a natural sense of familiarity. When we went camping, we just kept chatting under the stars until way past midnight!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you talk about?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: All sorts of things! One topic was about the limits of action, it gave me a lot to think about.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Like, if you've found a suspicious lead but need to enter a citizen's yard to investigate...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: How do you carry out the task in a way that keeps Mondstadt safe without infringing upon people's rights?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Liyue has well-developed regulations for situations like this, we Knights could learn so much from them!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Maybe we'll invite Yanfei to come by as a consultant more often in the future!

choices.text: I'm gonna look around a bit more.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Sure! Have fun!
